## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; mixed internals with major Tech and Financials ABOVE TREND while Energy and Healthcare lag, giving no clear directional conviction. Leadership concentrated: Narrow (4/5 Top performers in Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leading: AAPL (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +9.68%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +8.77% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary: TSLA (1W: +11.37% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND, BKNG (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate showing strength on flow (sector 1W: +3.12%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: CVX (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -9.03%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -3.25% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND. Utilities and Healthcare showing weakness: JNJ (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: SHOP (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: -11.96%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: +11.39% | 1M: +33.95%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +11.37% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CVX (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -9.03%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +7.30%) CORRECTION, COP (1W: -5.80% | 1M: -7.59%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: SHOP (1W: +17.54%), ORCL (1W: +14.11%), NOW (1W: +11.97%), AMD (1W: +11.39%), TSLA (1W: +11.37%); note NOW, PLTR, INTU are RECOVERY (1W up / 1M down) — tactical momentum but watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech broadly positive with many megacaps ABOVE TREND: NVDA (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +5.01% | 1M: +9.86%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND; pockets of RECOVERY (NOW, INTU, PLTR) suggest some short-term rotation despite sector strength (Technology 1W: +6.31%).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive with JPM (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +4.75%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND; watch WFC (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +7.30%) in CORRECTION for idiosyncratic risk.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed: UNH (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +15.35%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +0.26%) showing trend exhaustion; sector under slight pressure (Healthcare 1W: -0.83%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and selective large-cap Tech exposure (JPM, MSFT, AAPL, ORCL) and reduce exposure to Energy (CVX, XOM) until trend stabilizes; monitor RECOVERY names (NOW, INTU, PLTR) for confirmation before increasing exposure. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration but broad sector positivity.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment +50 confirming; AMZN (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +18.93%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CVX (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -9.03%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -3.25% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.82%) BELOW TREND — watch for macro/energy flows.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +6.31%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: +4.19%) given strong 1W leadership. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.94%) and Utilities (1W: -1.41%) where multiple names remain BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
ORCL: watch break above recent high for continuation (ABOVE TREND to extend). NVDA: hold above the current 1W momentum band to confirm further upside (ABOVE TREND). AAPL: keep 1M support intact to avoid short-term pullback (ABOVE TREND). CVX: watch for failure to reclaim 1M trend as trigger for deeper Energy weakness (BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (+50): Legendary value fund interest; ORCL (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. UNH (+60): analyst upgrades; UNH (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +15.35%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMZN (+50): AI/Anthropic tailwinds expected; AMZN (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +18.93%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
WFC (-50): downgrade headline; WFC (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +7.30%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligned with short-term weakness. (Other bearish headlines flagged in feed; several names lack price data in this packet — watch for confirming price action before acting.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration despite broad sector positivity. AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, ORCL ABOVE TREND and showing relative strength. Key risk: tactical RECOVERY names (NOW, PLTR, INTU) and Energy names (CVX, XOM) BELOW TREND — monitor news-driven divergences (e.g., LMT/ORCL headlines) for confirmation.
